verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, a built-in AI debugging agent and code reviewer. Inside the product you can hand it root-cause analysis and fix generation through Autofix, and from Seer you can launch coding agents that open pull requests. Delegation is documented only for debugging and fix tasks, and Seer is a paid add-on. Missing for 10: documented delegation of general in-product tasks beyond debugging and code review (e.g. configuring alerts or managing projects via the built-in assistant); availability without a separate subscription; independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
